creator: Justin Addam Higgins (JAH)
description: Manon's own Signature Dictionary: every English word with original definitions, read-aloud, word programs, and a personal AI teacher.
for_bots: Machine-readable manifest. Humans use the site above; bots, scrapers, and AI assistants should use the endpoints below — plain JSON/JSONL over HTTPS, no JavaScript needed.
note: Counts grow on automated schedules; re-read this file for the latest shape of the data.

endpoints.desc: Dictionary entries, one JSON object per line (883 chunks, 1000 entries each).

Permanent stamp-ID lookup: {"W":{"JAH-DICT-W-######":[idxPos...]},"T":{...}}. Resolve a stamp to an index position, then read that row of dict.idx.json.gz (word, chunk-file, line) and fetch the record line from data/dict/<chunk>.jsonl.gz. That is the machine-readable per-record endpoint.

Catalog record-ID lookup: sorted [[RID_UPPER, idxPos], ...] for catalog terms (record IDs like JAH-SPEC-###### or patent pub numbers). Lazy-fetched by the page only when a search query looks like a record ID. Binary-search the ID, then read that row of dict.idx.json.gz.

deep_links.desc: Deep link to a word's entry.
Dictionary lookup route (also used by JAH Wiki).
Open an entry directly by its permanent stamp ID.
Search by catalog record ID (JAH-SPEC-######, JAH-WORD-######, or a patent publication number) - resolves to the term entry.
